title: Example players sit below the article with no chrome so they look missing
description:
Live /examples pages boot a player, but it mounts after the article card with a transparent background and a green play button on a green page. Readers report no player at all.

## Behavior
The player is visible without scrolling past the article. It sits in a dedicated host above the spoken article, with a surface, border, and high-contrast Play control. Playwright asserts the host is visible and has a non-zero box.
right_now_summary: The player now sits above the article with a clear surface and visible Play button.
